comment: C-first corrected landmine recipe, frozen after the earlier target miss showed a gridbug More loop before set_trap completion. A distinct seed/date and source-supported level-10 wizard provide a clear attempt with enough HP for the landmine blast; the initial unknown-command space and pre-setup shoe-wear turn are removed. Step west off the upstairs, wish an uncursed land mine into the observed slot n, apply it, let set_trap complete, step east to the stairs, then return west onto the mine. Verify actual C reaches apply.c:use_trap/set_trap -> trap.c:maketrap/dotrap/trapeffect_landmine and records the damage/iron-shoe or no-shoe branch, pit conversion, recursion and fill_pit. If C shows a new setup or pager miss, preserve it and do not claim activation.
